# dsh-replay
**Read-only session review for DeepSeek Harness.**
Cost · Audit · Fork tree · Compare · Shareable HTML — **no model calls, no token spend.**
简体中文 · Live demo · Install · Why not Trajectory? · Privacy
> **Desktop one-click install:** **Plugins → Add plugin → `@mingozhou/dsh-replay` → Install** → rest

art.
> Web/source: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add …`.

15-second demo · sample sessions · the exported HTML is offline and read-only
GIF fallback · full de

-second demo · sample sessions · the exported HTML is offline and read-only
GIF fallback · full demo
> **“Replay” here means read-only.** dsh-replay never re-sends a session to a model, never writes th

e log, and never spends tokens. It parses the append-only session log and renders it. See FAQ.
>
> *
*Historical note (preserving the original claim).** ~~DeepSeek Harness keeps a beautiful append-only
log where everything that reached the model is reconstructible — but ships no viewer for it. **dsh-

replay is that viewer.**~~
> That was true when this project started in **2026-08**. Since **DSH 0.2
.1-rc.2**, the official Web UI ships the **Trajectory (轨迹)** view, which covers the current session'
s event ledger. dsh-replay is now the viewer for the **archive**: every session, cost, Windows-aware
audit, fork/compare, and redacted standalone export. Details below.
## Why not Trajectory?
Trajectory is excellent for **the session you are in**: a live ledger, timing overview, per-record t
okens, thinking, system prompt, virtual scrolling. If that is all you need, use it. dsh-replay is fo
r **after the session ends**, and for the questions Trajectory does not answer:
| | Official Trajectory | dsh-replay |

| Scope | current session | **all sessions + archive dashboard** |
| Timeline | native, live, virtua

lized | playback, reasoning, system prompt, tool summaries |
| Cost | token counts | **per-model cos

t, USD/CNY, editable price table** |
| Risk | — | **Windows-aware audit, baseline suppression, secre

t redaction** |
| Lineage | — | **fork tree + exact divergence + cost/risk deltas** |
| Sharing | ra

w session ZIP | **redacted, standalone, interactive HTML** |
| Data | in the session | **local archi
ve; no telemetry** |
The two coexist. dsh-replay does not replace Trajectory; it answers “what happened across all of thi
s, what did it cost, what was risky, and how do I show someone?”
## What you get
| 📊 **Archive dashboard** | Every session on this machine: month/all-time tokens, estimated cost, hi

gh-risk findings, search by title/id/workspace. |
| 💰 **Per-model cost** | Cache-aware totals, a per
-model breakdown, USD/CNY, and an editable price table. No more charging every token at one model's

rate. |
| 🛡️ **Windows-aware audit** | `pwsh`/PowerShell/`cmd` as well as bash; destructive deletes,
credential reads, exfil, persistence and policy changes. Initial permission/sandbox state is treate

d as baseline, not a finding. |
| 🔐 **Secret redaction** | Common API keys, `.env` assignments, priv

ate keys, home paths. The export dialog shows the redaction count before you share. |
| 📤 **Shareabl
e HTML** | One session baked into a single offline `.html`: no install, no network, no model. Ideal

for bug reports and post-mortems. |
| 🌿 **Fork tree** | Full lineage, subagents, fork boundaries, cl

ick-through. |
| ⚖️ **Compare** | Any two sessions: stats, tool mix, cost/risk deltas, full-lineage

relation, and the first differing event on each side. |
| ⏪ **Timeline** | 1–16× playback, reasoning

, system prompt, search, type filters, keyboard navigation, tool summaries instead of raw JSON. |
|
🌏 **English / 中文** | The app UI switches language; DSH-injected view labels remain whatever the host
/ 中文** | The app UI switches language; DSH-injected view labels remain whatever the host provides. |
## What changed in 0.4.2
This is the “still alive” maintenance release, focused on trust and first-run:
- **Audit correctness:** `pwsh`/PowerShell/`cmd`, Windows destructive commands, credential reads and
exfiltration; initial `permission/preset` / `sandbox/mode` no longer raises a finding; routine writ

es/network reads no longer flood the list.
- **Cost correctness:** per-model totals; mixed-model ses

sions are priced separately; editable price table; USD/CNY.
- **Share safely:** redaction preview +
count + size estimate; unredacted export is an explicit opt-in; exported viewer has no empty Forks/C

ompare tabs.
- **Actually smaller:** client bundle **2.0 MB → 232 KB**; mascot **1.4 MB → 73 KB**; R

EADME GIF **28.8 MB → 164 KB**; 15-second WebP **116 KB**.
- **More useful timeline:** reasoning, sy
stem prompt, model selection, tool summaries, keyboard navigation, selected-event preservation under

filters.
- **Archive dashboard:** every session, month/all-time, tokens, cost, risk, search, worksp

ace filter.
- **Privacy/security:** loopback-only API by default; secret redaction; PRIVACY.md and S

ECURITY.md.
- **Compatibility:** `engines.dsh`; targeted at DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 (the `sessionQuer
y` contract was checked against the running app; the UI was verified in demo mode).
## Compatibility
| Component | Tested / required |

| DSH Desktop | **0.2.1-rc.2** — target / API contract checked |
| DSH Web | 0.2.x expected (same `s

essionQuery` / webServer contract) |
| Node | **22+** |
| Package | `@mingozhou/dsh-replay@0.4.2` |
| Plugin API range | `engines.dsh >= 0.2.0-rc.8` |
DSH moves fast. If a future release breaks the adapter, `npm run demo` still works because the analy
sis/UI layers are independent of the host. Open an issue with the DSH version and the failing route.
## Privacy and security

- The plugin reads session logs through `ctx.sessionQuery`; it writes **no session data**.
- The UI

calls the **local DSH origin only**; no telemetry, no cloud parser.
- The host API is **loopback-onl
y by default** and read-only. `allowRemote` is an explicit opt-in and remains unauthenticated — do n

ot expose it to a network.
- Exported HTML is self-contained and offline. **Session logs are raw dat

a**: the export redacts common credentials, but review the file before sharing.
- Read PRIVACY.md an

t redacts common credentials, but review the file before sharing.
- Read PRIVACY.md and SECURITY.md.

evidence.fact: 该插件定位为面向 DeepSeek Harness 的只读会话审查工具。
功能涵盖成本、审计、Fork 树、会话对比及可分享 HTML，且不会发起模型调用或消耗 token。
evidence.quote: Cost · Audit · Fork tree · Compare · Shareable HTML — **no model calls, no token spend.**

evidence.fact: 插件用于跨会话查看发生过什么、成本多少、存在哪些风险以及如何向他人展示。
evidence.quote: s, what did it cost, what was risky, and how do I show someone?”

limitations: 作者称目标为 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，DSH Web 0.2.x 为预期兼容范围。
导出内容为自包含离线 HTML，但原始日志可能含敏感数据，分享前仍需检查。
远程访问需显式开启且未认证，不应暴露到网络。
output.summary_zh: 只读回放并归档管理本机 DeepSeek Harness 会话，提供时间线、逐步成本、风险审计、Fork 血缘和双会话对比；可导出离线交互 HTML，不调用模型。
